Readers and writers meet at a book fair.

The Frankfurt Book Fair opened in Germany on Wednesday. It brings together people who make, publish and enjoy books. More than four thousand publishing groups from over a hundred countries and regions are taking part. The event continues until Sunday.

Visitors can attend readings, talks and performances. They also have chances to meet writers and other people who work with books. Books for children and teenagers, as well as audiobooks, are among the important topics at this year's fair.

The Chinese display includes more than three thousand book titles. Chinese publishing and cultural groups are also planning fifty-five events, including talks with writers and introductions to new books. The fair gives readers a chance to discover stories from different places and learn about the people behind them.
